reasons.A: Clipped, clause-light sentences in quick succession and the manager's excuses rendered in free indirect speech ('He quite understood. Everybody wished to see his client.') come closest to the passage's staccato report and dry understatement, though its similes add an aphoristic flourish the author doesn't use.
reasons.D: Shares the ironic free-indirect rendering of the manager ('He was sorry. He was certain I would understand.') and the period diction, but its longer balanced periods and listing sentences are smoother and more composed than the author's telegraphic rhythm.
reasons.B: Has the parenthetical aside and some reported-speech irony, but its opening generalisation and the reflective, essayistic closing paragraph ('I have since thought a good deal...') move at a leisurely pace foreign to the passage's clipped log-like movement.
reasons.C: Modern, plain and earnest register with a sincere, explanatory resolution; no period feel, no ironic reported speech, and sentence movement unlike the author's terse fragments.
